finding.summary: Expansion clamps to used bounds that include the formula cell itself, creating self-references / cycles the dependency engine assumes cannot exist
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts expands `cell.f` against `await sheet.getUsedBounds()`, and `CellIndex.bounds()` (packages/sheets/src/store/cell-index.ts) covers *all* populated cells including the formula cells themselves. A formula placed inside the band it references — e.g. `=SUM(1:1)` in D1, or `=SUM(A:A)` in A5 — expands to a range that contains its own cell, so `buildDependantsMap` (packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts) records the cell as its own dependant. That violates the acyclicity invariant the topological recalculation/cycle detection relies on; expect a spurious `#REF!`/cycle error or a recalculation loop. Note the new tests deliberately place every formula in column D outside rows 1-3 (packages/sheets/test/sheet/calculation.test.ts, the `=SUM(1:3)` case at r5,c4), so this case is never exercised.
